study.question: Does applying the existing occupancy-dependent feedback interpolation to the direct slot-rate columns, as well as the event-content products, improve four-task validation macro AUC over the stronger source and current incumbent at unchanged capacity?
study.hypothesis: The incumbent exposes raw slot feedback fractions alongside shrunk joint-content products. These direct fractions provide an unsmoothed path even for one-event slots. Replacing only these direct columns by the same occupied-slot smoothed rates may condition the residual readout more usefully under the frozen one-pass optimizer. If occupancy-based interpolation matters, the smoothed-versus-raw gain should be greater with n/(n+4) than with a fixed half mixture. This is a prospective input-conditioning hypothesis, not a claim that raw rates have been proven harmful or that the new representation removes information.

nearest_work.difference: Closest source: same joint moments, backbone, all weights and widths. Change only four direct fraction columns per occupied residual slot to the already-computed shrunk rate. Retain zero direct rates for empty slots.

Inherits n/(n+4) versus half interpolation toward visible-user background, but tests its reach into direct feedback columns within the stronger relation-content residual model, rather than changing to the source compressed tower architecture.

DIN supplies inherited unnormalized target-conditioned local activation. Direct historical task-rate conditioning in fixed exclusive groups and the unified relation-token stack are adaptations beyond that paper; no priority claim.

Pinned benchmark code uses task masks to initialize sequence hubs and layer-wise interaction. This experiment retains the existing backbone and changes only direct rates in an eight-group residual. Original INFNet primary paper detail is unavailable in the authorized registry; novelty remains unverified.
README warns its historical behaviors lack item identity. No full-paper verification or transfer claim: this benchmark supplies past advertisement IDs and category/brand-matched auxiliary labels.

inherited_components: Complete g2-r0009-joint_count source backbone: sanitized inputs, static feature embeddings, DIN local activation, global/quartile relation summaries, JointBlock and four Dice towers.
Eight old/recent x category/brand-match groups, masked four-task fractions, counts, bias-free 8D feedback projection, joint covariance and zero-initialized 64-hidden logit residual.
Existing n/(n+4), strength four, versus fixed half local/global interpolation. No new registered modules or loss hook.
study.proposed_difference: Add direct_rate_mode raw|smoothed. Both modes compute occupied smoothed direct rates as gate * occupied; raw selects original fractions and smoothed selects these rates. Only the four explicit fraction columns in each slot change. Products and covariance keep their current count/fixed definitions. A two-by-two direct-rate x interpolation factorial isolates extension of shrinkage beyond the product path. Standalone modules have identical AST outside literal CONFIG.
predictions: Primary utility: direct_count exceeds raw_count and both frozen source macro AUCs (0.8275704845768582 and 0.8272805336635536), with all task AUC/Logloss and measured costs reported.

Occupancy-specific support: interaction (direct_count - raw_count) - (direct_fixed - raw_fixed) in macro AUC is positive; also report both simple count-minus-fixed effects. Do not infer support merely because direct_count is best of four.

New raw_count and raw_fixed reproduce archived joint_count and joint_fixed shared-state outputs; deterministic host runs should reproduce prior metrics within measured numerical tolerance. These controls are execution checks, not independent seed repetitions.

At the feature level empty direct slots stay zero, occupied n=4 count and fixed features coincide, dense local rates are preserved more strongly by count mixing, and perturbations to invalid history/task masks cannot change rates.

Exploratory history bins are inherited empty, 1-16, 17-64, >64 with per-task positive/negative counts. A history-bin result is not a direct test of slot sparsity; no slot-occupancy validation slice is currently available.
falsifiers: direct_count failing to exceed raw_count opposes this implementation benefit. If direct_fixed improves equally or more, occupancy-specific explanation is unsupported even if smoothing helps.
A favorable aggregate with material task trade-offs must be reported; it does not establish general benefit for each task. No undeclared per-task veto replaces the frozen macro selection rule.

If shared-state raw controls disagree with the pinned parents, masking fails, parameters/init differ, or losses/gradients are nonfinite, classify as an implementation failure and withhold scientific interpretation until resolved within budget.
No repeat confirmation or user-cluster interval means preliminary single-seed evidence; a tiny positive interaction is not established mechanism evidence.
alternative_explanations: One frozen seed cannot quantify seed variability or establish significance.
Deterministic rate transformation changes conditioning and gradients; it is not evidence of a calibrated statistical estimator.
Global background includes each slot and is not independent. Counts and the full set of rates may permit reconstruction of original rates; this does not add information.
Frozen one-pass optimization may favor an input scale; task utility and macro averaging may disagree.
